name: Fluid-Structure Interactions
description: Review of tensor algebra and tensor calculus, kinematics of continuum and conservation laws, variation al principles nonlinear dynamics of single and multi degree freedom systems, A solid in still fluid- vibro-acoustic coupling, interactions in viscous flow, interactions in a compressible flow, stability issues of axial flow models, buckling and flutter, Helmholtz resonator design, Reynolds equations spatial and temporal discretization, dynamics of thin structures, aero-elastic structures, FSI systems with potential flow, radiation and scattering of acoustic waves, computational models for FSI interactions, solution procedures and convergence issues.
